title: dummi-updater configuration
description: Trusted configuration for sequential Git updates and shell commands. Relative targets resolve against the config directory.

$schema.description: Editor schema URL; the updater does not fetch it. The add command fills a missing or empty URL with the schema URL from the example config.

free_size.description: Warn when disk space available to the current user on each target filesystem is below this percentage. Missing targets use the nearest existing parent directory. Checked before and after each enabled project; at most one warning per target per run, including Telegram when enabled, regardless of only_errors. Missing or null disables the check; 0% never warns. The add command fills missing or null free_size with 10%. Updates continue.

max_err_mb.description: Maximum logs/error.log size in decimal MB. Zero disables the file, not stderr.

max_project_mb.description: Maximum logs/project-output log size in decimal MB. Zero disables these files.

retention_days.description: Delete regular project-output-*.log files from logs/ after this many 24-hour days since last modification, at update or stop startup. Zero disables cleanup; null uses the default. error.log is not removed by age.

tg.description: Telegram settings. When omitted, TELEGRAM_* environment variables are used. Blank, null or missing bot_token and chat_id fall back independently to TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. Explicit enabled false always disables notifications. When enabled, credentials must be nonblank after environment fallback; the CLI validates this because JSON Schema cannot inspect environment variables. The add command fills missing or null settings with an explicit disabled block (enabled and only_errors false, bot_token and chat_id empty).

bot_token.description: Telegram bot token. Keep it secret.

repo.description: Clone URL; no leading or trailing whitespace. Must exactly match origin for existing repositories.

target.description: Project directory. Normalized targets must be unique; the CLI checks this.

run.description: Trusted shell command executed via sh -c in the target directory.

retry.description: Additional run attempts. Zero disables retries; null uses the default.

enabled.description: False skips the project; null uses the default.

logLimit.description: Decimal MB (1 MB = 1000000 bytes). Null uses the default; a positive limit must be at least one byte.
